stage_rules.A1: Exclude integrity, cleanup, finite-run, parameter, FLOP, >0.03 family-regression, or >1.10 step-time failures; rank remaining single-seed deltas descending and retain at most six. Positive delta is not required at this screen.
stage_rules.A2: Apply the registered paired three-seed provisional gate and retain at most four passing candidates by mean macro delta.
stage_rules.B: Apply the same provisional gate on Sudoku and routing. If fewer than two pass, open the sealed reserve exactly once and route it through A1, A2, and B under identical rules.
stage_rules.reserve_merge: Merge passing first-batch and reserve B decisions, rank by mean macro delta, and retain at most four for C. No second reserve is permitted.
stage_rules.C: Apply the paired three-seed provisional gate at 12M and retain at most two candidates separated by at least 0.35 standardized descriptor RMS distance.
stage_rules.D: Open locked evaluation only for the sealed Stage-D manifest; compare each finalist with its matched periodic control using training-depth per-example pairs.

final_inference.paired_randomization: one-sided per-example sign flip, 10000 deterministic resamples
final_inference.multiplicity: Holm step-down at alpha 0.05 across finalists
final_inference.pass_rule: 95% paired hierarchical bootstrap lower bound > 0 and Holm-rejected paired randomization null

resource_rules.calibration: 20 warm-up plus 30 measured steps on LSAD-C-K2L8 at S0/S1/S2; no task metrics emitted
resource_rules.profile: largest registered profile whose conservative mandatory path fits 24 GPU-hours with 1.2 safety factor

frozen_config_hash_rule: SHA-256 of canonical JSON after removing frozen_config_sha256
